HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

3. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in .

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
